metric_unit: sum(reported engine total cycles * reported pipe fraction) / sum(reported engine total cycles), dimensionless; not physical MFU or full-device busy
P5_model_rules: Conditional ordinary-shape work is not an unconditional MAC lower bound across all algorithms or transpose attributes.
Partial GEMM comparison uses exactly its selected execution times, not whole-module or request time.
A source tensor/weight/workspace size is not a universal necessary HBM byte count.
Independent resource lower bounds combine by max; mode/shared-pool accumulation requires proof.
No comparison ratio is a reachable speedup.
